notes: Eleven-a-side matches with a goalkeeper, goals and a knockout bracket are Sports, so the pitch takes space-bounded and the Field Sport preset; the answers add a compact arcade pitch inside a real modern World Cup venue with full stands, which brings in barrier-perimeter, spectator-bleachers for the tiered seating and npc-population for the cheering crowd. Party & Casual is named second because the spawn field where players gather between bracket rounds to pick a flag and shop is its social-hub, and nothing in Sports can express a lobby — the shape, preset and route all stay with Sports. I kept the match and the lobby on one continuous surface rather than taking space-staged: the prompt never asks for the pitch to be hidden from spawn, and that shape would cost P4 for nothing. The trophy at the centre of spawn and the shop front are real geometry that no loaded option row covers, so they ride along as free-text image detail; the penalty shootout is played on the same pitch and needs no separate space.
